boundary: heavy implementation WORKER; runs one claimed task in allowed_writes, validates, calls taskctl review, never finalizes done
orchestrator/reviewer/finalizer; a launched Codex worker must NOT self-review or finalize a task it executed
no local process and no API key held by orchestrator; human is executor and gate; renders a handoff packet only

requirement: GEOAI_TASK_MCP_ALLOW_LAUNCH=1 (default '0'); without it every request terminates blocked_launch_disabled
GEOAI_TASK_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES=1 (default '0'); write-gate parity required in addition to the launch flag
runner/topic pair on an explicit static allowlist; unknown/off-topic pair blocked and audited
launchable binary on command_allowlist ('claude' or 'codex'); no arbitrary command prepared or run
taskctl collision-guard passes immediately before launch; stale/conflicting claim blocks it
plan-only (dry-run) is the default; a real launch needs an explicit opt-in beyond the gate flags, never the default path
cwd pinned to GEOAI_REPO, scrubbed env, argv-list-only with no shell invocation, bounded timeout
concurrency cap (default 1) not exceeded; over-cap requests blocked to protect workstation and shared queue
append-only audit entry written for the launch decision; secret env values never logged
adapter available: read-only presence probe for local_cli, human-confirmed presence for manual_external
